title: Stadium
description: stadium.yaml: the tables of the tournament battle overlay (STD_REL.BIN).

opponent_base_stats.description: STD_OPPONENT_BASE_STATS: the base stat of the opponents, by tournament (STD_initializeOpponent).

grades.description: STD_GRADES: the TIM of each tournament's grade (STD_initializeTournament).

win_chances.description: The chance of each outcome by the levels of the two fighters, [level A - 3][level B - 3] (STD_setupParticipants).

camera_presets.description: Six values each, passed in order to the overlay's setCameraParams.

arenas.description: The arenas with files: the model, TIM and collision paths and how many objects and TIMs they hold (loadArenaAssets; the counts live in the executable).
